question: If x, y and z are positive numbers and x + y + z = 1, then the least value of (1)/(x) + (1)/(y) + (1)/(z) is:
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ For symmetric minimum value problems, the extreme value occurs when all variables are equal. Given x + y + z = 1, we set x = y = z. ⇒ 3x = 1 ⇒ x = 1/3, y = 1/3, z = 1/3. Substitute these values to find the least value: ⇒ 1/x + 1/y + 1/z = 1/(1/3) + 1/(1/3) + 1/(1/3) = 3 + 3 + 3 = 9 **∴ The correct answer is 9.**
